m: Login uses Auth0 for both the web app and the API.
c: Auth0 handles sign-in for the frontend and the backend.

m: Store dates as UTC ISO-8601 strings.
c: All timestamps are saved in UTC as ISO 8601 text.

m: Never add co-author lines to commits.
c: Commits must not carry Co-Authored-By trailers.

m: Use one SQLite file per project.
c: Each project gets its own SQLite database file.

m: Moved the API servers from Oracle Cloud to AWS.
c: The backend is hosted on Oracle Cloud.

m: Switched the job queue from Redis to Postgres SKIP LOCKED to drop a dependency.
c: Background jobs run on a Redis queue (BullMQ).

m: Search now ranks results by combined keyword and vector scores.
c: Search ranks results by keyword BM25 only.

m: The default extraction model is muse-spark-1.3 on Meta's API.
c: The default extraction model is llama3.1 through Ollama.

m: Session tokens now expire after 7 days.
c: Session tokens expire after 30 days.

m: The search cache holds at most 500 entries.
c: Search results are cached for 60 seconds.

m: Auth0 tokens are verified against the tenant's JWKS, cached for 10 minutes.
c: Both apps use Auth0 for authentication.

m: Snapshot commits use the identity MemoryOS <memoryos@localhost>.
c: Uncommitted work is saved as snapshot commits on refs/engram/snapshots.

m: PostgreSQL backups run nightly at 02:00 UTC to object storage.
c: The backend stores its data in PostgreSQL on the same host.

m: Row-level security policies assume every request sets app.user_id from the Auth0 subject.
c: Both apps authenticate users with Auth0.

m: The deploy script restarts the API with systemctl on the Oracle VM.
c: The backend is hosted on an Oracle Cloud VM.

m: The frontend reads secrets at build time through the Infisical CLI.
c: Secrets are managed in Infisical.

m: The mobile app keeps the session in a cookie.
c: The mobile app cannot hold cookies, so it sends bearer tokens.

m: The graph view renders in 3D with WebGL.
c: The graph is a 2D canvas like Obsidian's; 3D views were dropped.

m: Embeddings are computed through OpenAI's API.
c: embeddings run on the CPU inside the app with a built-in model.

m: Auth0 rate-limits the /oauth/token endpoint to 30 requests per second.
c: Gmail sends the password reset emails.

m: The UI uses the system font stack.
c: The graph uses a force-directed layout.

m: Backend logs are written as JSON to stdout.
c: backend is hosted on Oracle.

m: The PostgreSQL connection pool size is 20.
c: Redis is no longer used.

m: Codex connects over MCP with a bearer token in config.toml.
c: Claude Code gets a SessionStart hook that injects the brief.

m: Ollama's context window is raised to 16k tokens.
c: Muse Spark costs $1.25 per million input tokens.

m: Tests use an in-memory SQLite database.
c: Each project gets its own SQLite database file.

m: The Dock icon is a wireframe brain.
c: The app is named MemoryOS.

m: The settings page masks API keys.
c: Switching embedding models re-embeds everything on save.

m: The careerbricks frontend is deployed to Cloudflare Pages.
c: The careerbricks backend is hosted on Oracle.
